title: A dense adapted polynomial chart of the Bertini incidence scheme
statement: Under precisely the hypotheses of lem-zl-bertini-generic-fibre-chart and for any prescribed basis of V, there exist a finite type k-domain A, n≥2, g₁,…,gₙ∈A, with a component of V(g₁,g₂) of dimension dim A−2 and geometrically irreducible Spec Frac A, a dominant map j:Spec A[x₁,…,xₙ]→H surjective on stalks, and an isomorphism c of the original parameter affine space with Spec k[t₀,…,tₙ], such that j≫q≫c is exactly t₀↦−Σgᵢxᵢ, tᵢ↦xᵢ.

source.place: Tag 0G4F, proof; tensor-pullback and affine-coordinate details

proof.text: Choose an affine open avoiding the first section zero locus and meeting the codimension-two component. Pass to the quotient of its coordinate ring by the nilradical. This is a finite type domain; the quotient spectrum is a universal homeomorphism, so the chosen component and codimension survive, and geometric irreducibility survives every base change. The generic residue criterion gives geometric irreducibility of its fraction field.

Codimension of a maximal irreducible closed subset is preserved on open restriction. The height-two minimal prime over the second and third coefficients rules out a linear dependence by the principal ideal theorem. The first coefficient is one, so the three vectors are independent. Extend them to a basis. The dimension formula at a prime and the transcendence-degree formula for a finite type domain give dim(A/p)+height(p)=dim A.

On every nonempty affine trivialization, pass to the reduced domain and transfer the base-locus component codimension bound to the coefficient ideal. A section nonzero somewhere cannot have zero coefficient on a nonempty open of the irreducible base. Apply affine incidence irreducibility. Naturality identifies each resulting image with the preimage of that affine open. The zero-parameter section makes all pairs of such images intersect; the open-cover criterion proves H irreducible.

Apply the affine incidence presentation, the compatible basis-coordinate change and elimination of the first variable. Their evaluation formulas prove the asserted projection equation. Naturality preserves surjectivity on stalks under base change. The chart image is a nonempty open subset of the irreducible H, hence dense.

theorem exists_bertiniIncidenceAdaptedChart
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (V : Type v) [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [FiniteDimensional k V] :
    letI : Module k Γ(L, ⊤) :=
      Module.compHom Γ(L, ⊤) (Scheme.globalSectionsRingHom k (X := Y))
    ∀ ψ : V →ₗ[k] Γ(L, ⊤),
      (∃ (v₁ v₂ v₃ : V) (W : TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds Y),
        Maximal (fun Z : TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds Y ↦
          (Z : Set Y) ⊆ (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (ψ v₂)).zeroLocus.support ∩
            (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (ψ v₃)).zeroLocus.support) W ∧
        ¬ (W : Set Y) ⊆ (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (ψ v₁)).zeroLocus.support ∧
        Order.coheight W = 2) →
      (∀ B : TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds Y,
        Maximal (fun Z : TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds Y ↦
          (Z : Set Y) ⊆ ⋂ w : V,
            ((Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (ψ w)).zeroLocus.support : Set Y)) B →
        2 ≤ Order.coheight B) →
      ∀ (r : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k V),
      ∃ (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (a : Algebra k A),
        letI := a
        ∃ (hft : Algebra.FiniteType k A) (hdom : IsDomain A),
          letI := hft
          letI := hdom
          ∃ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (g : Fin n → A),
            (∃ W : Set (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
                ({g ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn⟩, g ⟨1, hn⟩} : Set A)),
              W ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
                ({g ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hn⟩, g ⟨1, hn⟩} : Set A)) ∧
              topologicalKrullDim W + 2 = ringKrullDim A) ∧
            GeometricallyIrreducible
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (FractionRing A)))) ∧
            ∃ (j : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A)) ⟶
                (bertiniUniversalIdeal (Y ↘ Spec (.of k)) L
                  (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ ψ (b i.down))).subscheme)
              (c : Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) k)) ≅
                Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k))),
              IsDominant j ∧ SurjectiveOnStalks j ∧
              j ≫ bertiniUniversalProjection (Y ↘ Spec (.of k)) L
                  (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ ψ (b i.down)) ≫ c.hom =
                bertiniEliminatedProjection k A n g
